goal: Reduce offline backup footprint through verified lossless compression, preserving all three recovery snapshots
acceptance: Three dated offline snapshots preserved in lossless archives
Full gzip decompression size/CRC/SHA256 verified before exact source unlink
No active runtime/source/cache or app changes
Private archive ACLs and manifests; public sanitized receipts only
Before/after measured free space; independent review before source removal
affected: Three exact offline VHD backup paths from STORAGE-001 and historical migration
dependencies: Python Windows3.13 gzip/hashlib/Win32 source read locks
Source identity and target capacity checks
start_conditions: Exact backup path scope and review ready
permissions: Compress and reorganize exact offline backups locally; remove uncompressed duplicates only after full decompressed checksum match
Write private archive manifests outside Git and sanitized task receipts
No removal of an entire recovery snapshot, no runtime stop/start/prune, no app edits or merge/release
stop_conditions: Source identity changes or SHA mismatch
Compression not beneficial or decompression integrity failure
